repo: The monokl repo uses git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ for parallel agent work, each on a branch named worktree-agent-<id>.
Mutation testing is used to verify that new pinning tests actually kill surviving mutants.

workflow: A subagent can stop while its own background work is still running; its task-notification result is then interim, and the final report arrives later via SubagentHandback under the same task-id.
Long-running mutation-test agents can take a long time (this one ran about 24 minutes and used 64 tool calls).
